title: Choose Your Basalt
summary: Dead-pan educational cabaret duet: Lillith and Rubella classify lava types in their gothic living room, then the floor opens onto magma. Ends with “That’s nature for us” / “Science.” before a Twilight Time trance smash-cut.
visualArc: House interior (black lace + Hawaiian leis) → heat shimmer in floorboards → cracked living-room floor → lava tubes beneath the foundation → white-flash smash-cut into trance remix.
